name: io.github.florinvica/msbuild-graph-mcp
description: Pre-build static analysis of MSBuild solutions — dependency graphs, TFM compatibility, shared imports, configuration diffs, package version consistency, and impact analysis for LLM-powered coding assistants.

allowed_paths.description: Semicolon-separated list of allowed directories for project evaluation. Leave empty to allow all paths.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for graph construction (default: 120).
